title.title: Quantum geometric Langlands at irrational level
title.subtitle: Claim: $D_c(\mathrm{Bun}_G) \simeq D_{-1/(rc)}(\mathrm{Bun}_{G^\vee})$ for every simple $G$, curve and $c \notin \mathbb{Q}$

plain: A deep dictionary between two kinds of symmetry, stretched by a dial; claimed at every irrational setting

beats.text: Quantum Langlands deforms geometric Langlands by a level $c$
The claim covers every irrational $c$, real or not; rational levels are left out
Twisted D-modules at level $c$ match those for the dual group at $-1/(rc)$

achievement.label: Quantum geometric Langlands (Gaitsgory), irrational level
achievement.context: Before: the classical, critical-level case by Gaitsgory–Raskin et al. (2024)
achievement.note: Rational and critical levels are excluded

verify.detail: No Lean; 119 pages, a single paper
verify.ourCheck: We read the claim and caveats; we did not check the proof

voice.text: Quantum Langlands matches twisted D-modules for a group and for its dual group.
The levels are c and minus one over r c.
Claimed: every simple group and curve, c irrational.

sources.quote: The classical (critical level) unramified geometric Langlands was proved by Gaitsgory–Raskin et al. (2024, 5-paper series)
